Unlimited Korean Fried Chicken (KFC) with a drink included for only £20. @cheemclondon in Soho is a place to go all out with your mates. This deal is available Monday to Thursday only. Do not pull up on weekends expecting to get this🤦🏾‍♂️

They have 11 flavours on offer which I think is excellent. You get 6 wings in every portion & you can also choose boneless pieces too. I tried every flavour & probably bar two, I liked every one. Especially the Honey Butter, a powdery substance but it’s like it melt into the batter of the wing. It was crazy!

The Order:

🍗 Unlimited Wings & Drink £20
🍗 Flavours On Offer: Naked, Honey Butter, Korean BBQ, Sweet Chilli, Red Devil, Sweet Soy, Korean Buffalo, Hawaiian Volcano, Mad Garlic, Creamion, Oriental Green

Overall = 4.5/5

A must visit in Soho 😮‍💨

AD- INVITE | @thirteen_ldn has been on my radar for a month now and I needed to check it out, especially as the food is created by @cuepointldn 🤤 This is a stunning bar that’s opened a few months ago in Tottenham Court Road and it’s definitely a secret as it doesn’t seem very popular..yet 👀

The food here is so good. We had the No.2 sharing plate which had two of the following: brisket slider, smoked chicken Naan tacos, pumpkin naan tacos, aubergine naan tacos, Zaatar potatoes. This was £39 between two people. Honestly the chicken tacos are my favourite and I will definitely go anywhere where @cuepointldn makes the food 😂 The drinks are stunning too as we had the Soho (£16) and the Lady Stardust (£16). Really recommend checking this out!

Location: Tottenham Court Road
Price: ££-£££
Requirements: vegetarian options available, mocktails available, Halal food but double check

reel.caption:
Tiramisu French Toast of dreams @thegrandportobello 😍

This has been on my list for a while and I'm glad I finally tried it! It was really good 👌

The toast itself is so thick and fluffy and it's topped with Mascarpone Cream and Cocoa Powder. The cream does get a little sweet towards the end but it's too good not to finish 😅 

I personally think it would have been nice to have a bit of espresso on the side to dunk it in ☕️
